final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM major_counts) SELECT link_to_major, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as fraction FROM major_counts ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
